name: Loge
source:
Loge was a Mahoutsukai who massacred many people during the Ten-Year War, Fimbulwinter. He was the one who instigated all the events in fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase. 

fortissimo//Akkord:nächsten Phase Description

[spoiler]During the last battle of Fimbulwinter, Loge's rampage occurred at the hospital where Yoshino Sousei's wife, Yoshino Sakura was being treated at. Despite Sousei's efforts to protect her, Sakura dies by Loge's flames. This in turn led Sousei to become Odin and 'killed' Loge out of anger and revenge. And thus, Odin sought to create another Mahoutsukai ritual called Ragnarök in order to revive his deceased wife.[/spoiler]

Kadenz fermata//Akkord:fortissimo Description

[spoiler]It is revealed in the final Day of the story that Loge never died from Yoshino Sousei and was able to possess Julius (first playthrough only) and Freya. He is the true main antagonist of the game.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]His voice actors depend on who he is possessing. When he possesses Julius, he has his voice, and when he possesses Freya, he has her voice.[/spoiler]
